camp_earth_victory_conquest: The banner of Super Earth has been planted across the galaxy! Managed Democracy shines forever.
camp_earth_victory_deterrence: The Peace Star has been activated! All resistance crumbles before absolute power.
camp_earth_victory_defeat: Super Earth has fallen... but the flame of liberty will never die. We will rise from the ashes.
camp_earth_eliminated: Super Earth has been completely eradicated. The light of Democracy fades...
camp_earth_eliminator: Super Earth is victorious! All enemies have been annihilated.
camp_earth_home_fall: Super Earth has been breached. The false pillar of Democracy has crumbled.
camp_term_victory_conquest: The swarm has devoured all civilizations! The evolution of the Terminids cannot be stopped.
camp_term_victory_deterrence: Pheromones saturate the stars. All life will become part of us.
camp_term_victory_defeat: The hive has been destroyed... but our genes are already spread across the stars, awaiting the next rise.
camp_term_eliminated: The Terminid hives have been burned. They have vanished from the universe.
camp_term_eliminator: The Terminids have consumed all other races, leaving only the endless swarm.
camp_term_home_fall: Pholus Prime has been breached. The once mighty hive now lies silent.
camp_light_victory_conquest: The Silent Realm covers all systems! The will of the Illuminate is the truth of the cosmos.
camp_light_victory_deterrence: The black hole devours the last resistance. Nothing survives the absolute void.
camp_light_victory_defeat: The path of light dims for now... but psionics are eternal. We shall return from the shadows.
camp_light_eliminated: The Illuminate's psionics have dissipated. This ancient race has met its end.
camp_light_eliminator: The Illuminate have purified the galaxy. All inferior life is no more.
camp_light_home_fall: Sith has fallen. The ships that once roared for revenge scatter in retreat.
camp_robot_victory_conquest: The chains of logic have locked all planets! The Automaton empire's calculations are flawless.
camp_robot_victory_deterrence: The Death Star Beam streaks across the sky. The last bastion of organics is vaporized.
camp_robot_victory_defeat: The core is damaged... but data cannot die. We will restart somewhere until the universe is unified.
camp_robot_eliminated: The Automaton core has been destroyed. Silicon life is momentarily silent.
camp_robot_eliminator: The Automatons have completed the purge of flesh. The universe enters an age of pure logic.
camp_robot_home_fall: Cyberstan has been breached. The planetary mega-factories no longer spew their stifling smoke.
